items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a gentle way to start for the look of fine lines.
Retinol can make skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 protects the look of your skin.
Your scan shows low moisture, and a ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier while you start retinol.

response.routine_note: At night, use a pea-sized amount of retinol on clean, dry skin just 2 nights a week, then add nights slowly as your skin feels comfortable, and follow with moisturizer. Apply sunscreen every morning, and skip exfoliating acids and scrubs while you begin.
